headline: Approved four commissioner appointments and reassignments to committees and a school liaison role.
summary: Commissioners were appointed or reassigned to the Policy, Finance & Operations, and School Safety committees, and as Ivy Drive School Liaison. All four motions carried.
decisions: Approved reassigning Commissioner Ledger from alternate to committee member and appointing Commissioner Hick as alternate to the Policy Committee; motion carried.
Approved removing Commissioner Ledger from Finance & Operations and appointing Commissioner Hick as a committee member; motion carried.
Approved appointing Commissioner Hick as School Safety committee member; motion carried.
Approved appointing Commissioner Hick as Ivy Drive School Liaison; motion carried.

decision_evidence.quote: Chair Pons called for a motion to approve the reassignment of Commissioner Ledger from Alternate to Committee Member and appointment of Commissioner Hick as alternate to the Policy Committee. ... Motion was made by Commissioner Jennifer Tagariello and seconded by Commissioner Jill Ftizsimons Bula. Motion Carried.

Chair Pons called for a motion to approve the removal of Commissioner Ledger from Finance & Operations and the appointment of Commissioner Hick as Finance & Operations committee member. ... Motion was made by Commissioner Jennifer Tagariello and seconded by Commissioner Robert Parenti. Motion Carried.

Chair Pons called for a motion to approve the appointment of Commissioner Hick as School Safety committee member ... Motion was made by Commissioner Jennifer Tagariello and seconded by Commissioner Kara Ledger. Motion Carried.

Chair Pons called for a motion to approve the appointment of Commissioner Hick as Ivy Drive School Liaison. ... Motion was made by Commissioner Jennifer Tagariello and seconded by Commissioner Jill Ftizsimons Bula. Motion Carried.
